shots.line: What If You Had 1000 IQ?
shots.scene: Title card: glowing caps question over the chess hall at dusk, long table, one lit window, the hero a small silhouette at the far end.

shots.line: You glance at the chessboard once.
shots.scene: Insert: chessboard from above, pieces in endgame layout, thin gold grid beginning to glow on the squares.

shots.line: You already see the next forty moves.
shots.scene: Reveal: forty ghost future-moves fan out over the board in gold line-art while the hero sits motionless, slow push-in.

shots.line: Your teacher writes a six digit multiplication on the board.
shots.scene: Establishing wide: morning classroom, teacher writing six digits on the chalkboard, hero at a desk in the third row, dust in the window light.

shots.line: You answer before she drops the chalk.
shots.scene: Medium single: hero raises one hand without looking up, gold answer digits floating above the desk.

shots.line: You answer before she drops the chalk.
shots.scene: Insert: the teacher’s chalk still touching the board, her hand frozen mid-stroke, 451,608 glowing under it.

shots.line: Your friend Leo hands you a tangled charger cable.
shots.scene: Medium two-shot: school hallway at the lockers, Leo on the left holding out a knotted charger cable, hero reaching for it.

shots.line: You hand it back... untangled...
shots.scene: Interaction: the hero takes the tangled cable in both hands, the knot outlined in red; on "untangled" it comes loose in a blur of speed lines with a 2.00 s readout stamping in.

shots.line: in two seconds.
shots.scene: Two-shot: the neat coil lands back in Leo’s open hands, Leo’s jaw dropped, hero shrugging.

shots.line: The bus timetable, the weather, the crossword, the crowd’s exact head count.
shots.scene: Insert: bus timetable board at a shelter, departure rows lighting up one by one.

shots.line: The bus timetable, the weather, the crossword, the crowd’s exact head count.
shots.scene: Insert: a weather map with pressure numbers and a rain percentage counting up.

shots.line: The bus timetable, the weather, the crossword, the crowd’s exact head count.
shots.scene: Insert: newspaper crossword grid, letters dropping into the squares.

shots.line: The bus timetable, the weather, the crossword, the crowd’s exact head count.
shots.scene: Top-down wide: a crowd at the crossroads, small ink figures, an exact head count ticking in gold.

shots.line: Done. Done. Done. Done.
shots.scene: Stamp montage on one board: four DONE badges slam in sequence, one per spoken "Done", each on its own task card.

shots.line: And your toast...
shots.scene: Medium single: hero at the kitchen counter staring into nothing, morning light, toaster behind him.

shots.line: is still in the toaster.
shots.scene: Insert: the toaster with two slices still upright inside, one amber NOT DONE badge over it.

shots.line: The average human scores around one hundred on an IQ test. The smartest people ever measured hover near two hundred.
shots.scene: Blueprint data card: the IQ bell curve drawing itself with markers at 100 AVERAGE and 200 HIGHEST RECORDED.

shots.line: You? One thousand.
shots.scene: Giant close-up: the hero’s face fills the frame while a gold counter rolls from 0 to 1000 beside the head.

shots.line: Five times past the edge of the chart.
shots.scene: Reveal: the chart axis snaps and the gold bar shoots off the top of the frame, the scale shattering like glass.

shots.line: But here’s the rule.
shots.scene: Medium single in the void: the hero standing in one rim light, camera slow push, THE RULE line above him.

shots.line: Your brain got faster.
shots.scene: Blueprint: a head in profile with the brain lighting up, speed arcs and clock hands spinning inside it.

shots.line: Your body didn’t.
shots.scene: Medium single: the same hero’s body slumped and slow in the desk chair, one arm dangling, comic stillness.

shots.line: You can calculate a falling glass perfectly...
shots.scene: Freeze frame: a glass slipping off a counter hangs mid-air with a dotted fall path and timing math around it.

shots.line: You can calculate a falling glass perfectly... and still be half a second too slow to catch it.
shots.scene: Interaction: the hero’s hand closes on empty air a half-second late, frozen droplets hanging around the fingers.

shots.line: and still be half a second too slow to catch it.
shots.scene: Wide: kitchen floor, glass shattered in a wet arc, the hero standing over it looking at his own hand.

shots.line: So what if you had one thousand IQ?
shots.scene: Chapter line SO WHAT IF YOU HAD 1000 IQ? over a wide classroom, camera drifting sideways.

shots.line: At school, you finish a two hour exam in four minutes.
shots.scene: Insert: the capped pen on a full answer sheet, 4:00 readout against a 2:00:00 normal time.

shots.line: Leo stares at your blank extra time.
shots.scene: Two-shot: Leo at the next desk staring at his own blank paper while the hero leans back relaxed.

shots.line: Dude. You just sat there.
shots.scene: Giant close-up: Leo talking to camera, Dude. You just sat there., edge of blank paper in frame.

shots.line: I was proving it three more ways, you say.
shots.scene: Medium single: hero at his desk with three small blueprint proofs floating around his head.

shots.line: For fun.
shots.scene: Giant close-up: the hero’s smirk landing on For fun.

shots.line: Plus: you learn a new language over one lunch period.
shots.scene: Two-shot: cafeteria table, hero and Leo with trays, foreign word cards floating between them.

shots.line: Grammar, verbs, slang, done by dessert.
shots.scene: Insert: a dessert plate with a stack of grammar cards balanced on it and a DONE stamp.

shots.line: Minus: you also notice every tiny lie people tell without meaning to.
shots.scene: Establishing wide: evening kitchen, mom at the stove, hero in the doorway, warm window over the sink.

shots.line: Your mom says dinner’s almost ready.
shots.scene: Medium single: mom turns with a smile, a speech bubble forming and a red tag starting to open above it.

shots.line: It is not almost ready.
shots.scene: Giant close-up: the hero flat and knowing, a red NOT READY tag glowing beside the face.

shots.line: You know this from the pan sounds.
shots.scene: Insert: an empty pan on the burner with two drops of oil, a waveform readout pinned at zero.

shots.line: In chess club, you beat the state champion in nine moves.
shots.scene: Establishing wide: chess club room, long tables, hero facing the state champion, chess clock between them.

shots.line: He stares at the board.
shots.scene: Insert: the board from above, nine ghost moves replaying as gold arcs, a 9 badge in the corner.

shots.line: How... how did you do that?
shots.scene: Giant close-up: the champion staring at the board, How... how did you do that? lip-synced.

shots.line: I didn’t, you say.
shots.scene: Medium single: the hero shrugging, I didn’t, hands open.

shots.line: The board did. I just read it.
shots.scene: Insert: the empty board alone, its grid lines glowing and reading themselves out in blueprint light.

shots.line: But where it gets really crazy...
shots.scene: Chapter line BUT WHERE IT GETS REALLY CRAZY over a wide dusk city, traffic moving below.

shots.line: is the systems.
shots.scene: Reveal: wireframe overlays boot up across the whole street as the hero walks, camera pulling out and up.

shots.line: You glance at a stock chart once and see the crash three days early.
shots.scene: Insert: a phone screen stock chart, a dashed line drawing the crash three days ahead of the real curve.

shots.line: You glance at a stock chart once and see the crash three days early.
shots.scene: Data card: CRASH PREDICTED -3 DAYS with the red curve falling on cue.

shots.line: You look at your city’s traffic lights and redesign the timing in your head, cutting the morning jam in half.
shots.scene: 3D orbit: city intersection at dawn, cars queued, traffic light poles and timing lines.

shots.line: You look at your city’s traffic lights and redesign the timing in your head, cutting the morning jam in half.
shots.scene: Top-down diagram: the signal timing grid rewriting itself as green waves flow through the junction.

shots.line: You look at your city’s traffic lights and redesign the timing in your head, cutting the morning jam in half.
shots.scene: Compare bars: MORNING JAM before and after, the second bar halving in place.

shots.line: A real engineer would need a team, and months.
shots.scene: Blueprint: a team of engineer figures under a months-long timeline, above one small figure holding a lamp.

shots.line: You needed a red light.
shots.scene: Medium single: the hero at a red traffic light at dawn, one finger on the pole, small private smile.

shots.line: And there’s a cost nobody warns you about.
shots.scene: Wide: bedroom at 2 AM, hero lying awake in moonlight, blue numbers streaming across the ceiling.

shots.line: You can’t turn it off. Ever.
shots.scene: Giant close-up: the hero’s eyes wide open, data streams reflecting across the face, Ever landing hard.

shots.line: The fridge hum becomes a frequency you calculate instead of ignore.
shots.scene: Insert: a fridge glowing in the dark kitchen, its hum drawn as a waveform with a 59.7 Hz readout.

shots.line: The ceiling fan becomes a geometry problem at two in the morning.
shots.scene: Top-down insert: the ceiling fan with geometry arcs over the blades and a 2:00 badge in the corner.

shots.line: You lie there... running numbers you never asked for...
shots.scene: Medium single: the hero on his back, numbers running across his face, camera slow push toward the bed.

shots.line: while the whole street sleeps.
shots.scene: Wide pull-out through the window: the sleeping street below, one lit window left in the whole row.

shots.line: A normal brain filters out ninety nine percent of what it senses.
shots.scene: Blueprint: a normal brain funnel discarding ninety-nine percent of the signals pouring in.

shots.line: Yours filters out almost nothing.
shots.scene: Blueprint: the hero’s funnel standing wide open, every signal passing straight through.

shots.line: Mia, your lab partner, taps your shoulder.
shots.scene: Two-shot: school lab, Mia tapping the hero’s shoulder while he faces the wall.

shots.line: You’ve been staring at that wall for an hour.
shots.scene: Medium single: the hero still facing the wall, Mia’s blurred shoulder in the foreground.

shots.line: I was mapping the crack pattern, you say.
shots.scene: Insert: the wall crack spreading into a branching blueprint pattern with measured angles.

shots.line: It’s actually kind of beautiful.
shots.scene: Giant close-up: the hero soft and honest, It’s actually kind of beautiful.

shots.line: That’s the real price.
shots.scene: Wide in the void: the hero small under the line THAT’S THE REAL PRICE.

shots.line: Dopamine, the brain’s little reward spark, fires hardest for surprises.
shots.scene: Blueprint: a brain with one dopamine spark firing bright over a SURPRISE label.

shots.line: For things you didn’t see coming.
shots.scene: Blueprint: the reward meter only filling when an unknown arrives at the gate.

shots.line: But you always see it coming.
shots.scene: Giant close-up: the hero’s flat face next to an empty reward meter.

shots.line: The movie twist.
shots.scene: Insert: a movie poster with the twist typed straight across it and a SPOILER stamp.

shots.line: The pop quiz.
shots.scene: Insert: a pop quiz paper already filled in before the bell has finished ringing.

shots.line: The surprise party.
shots.scene: Wide: a surprise party frozen mid-cheer, the hero standing in the middle under a crossed-out banner.

shots.line: All solved in advance.
shots.scene: Three SOLVED stamps land in a row over the poster, the quiz and the party.

shots.line: Nothing left... to feel surprised by.
shots.scene: Wide: the hero alone in a dark room, the reward meter dim and empty beside him.

shots.line: And Leo notices before anyone else does.
shots.scene: Two-shot: cafeteria, Leo watching the hero from across the table, tray untouched.

shots.line: He’s known you since you were seven.
shots.scene: Warm flashback wide: two seven-year-olds at the same table, same yellow cap and navy hoodie.

shots.line: Same table, every lunch, for years.
shots.scene: Top-down match: the same table across the years, two pairs of trays stacked above each other.

shots.line: Same dumb knock on your door...
shots.scene: Insert: a closed door with three knock rings spreading across it, then one.

shots.line: three taps, then one.
shots.scene: Medium single: the hero at his desk turning round as the knock pattern reads out 3 + 1.

shots.line: He still does it, even now.
shots.scene: Two-shot: Leo in the bright doorway, the hero at the desk, the held beat between them.

shots.line: One afternoon he finds you just sitting in the dark.
shots.scene: Wide: the hero sitting on the floor in the dark, Leo a bright shape in the open door.

shots.line: You used to laugh at my terrible jokes, he says quietly.
shots.scene: Medium single: Leo on the floor beside him, talking quietly, knees up.

shots.line: Now you just... solve them before I finish.
shots.scene: Giant close-up: the hero hearing a joke he already finished, Leo’s voice off-screen.

shots.line: I miss confusing you.
shots.scene: Giant close-up: Leo’s face, I miss confusing you.

shots.line: That hits harder than any equation.
shots.scene: Wide: the hero alone again, the equations on his wall dimming out one by one.

shots.line: Then an organization shows up.
shots.scene: Wide: night street, a black car at the curb under a lamp, the hero small and approaching.

shots.line: Sharp suits.
shots.scene: Insert: three pairs of shoes and suit hems on wet pavement, no faces in frame.

shots.line: Soft voices.
shots.scene: Medium single: Mr Black half in shadow at the head of the table, fedora, hands folded.

shots.line: A man named Mr. Black offers you a lab, a salary, a future.
shots.scene: Two-shot: boardroom table, Mr Black offering across it, the hero seated with arms crossed.

shots.line: Just solve our market models, he says.
shots.scene: Blueprint: market models as rotating grids and curves with a SOLVE label over them.

shots.line: Nothing illegal. Just... profitable.
shots.scene: Giant close-up: Mr Black behind dark sunglasses, Nothing illegal. Just... profitable.

shots.line: You could predict every trade on Earth by lunch.
shots.scene: Data card: a world map with trade arcs lighting up and a counter running.

shots.line: You could be rich by Friday.
shots.scene: Reveal: gold stacking into a tower beside a calendar flipping to Friday.

shots.line: The catch?
shots.scene: Giant close-up: the hero’s eyes narrowing on The catch?

shots.line: Their numbers don’t add up.
shots.scene: Insert: a ledger column of numbers with one row in red and the sum mismatched.

shots.line: You run them twice.
shots.scene: Split insert: the same calculation run twice side by side, the same red row both times.

shots.line: Real people lose their savings so the firm wins.
shots.scene: Wide: a city of tiny figures as coins fall away from their hands toward a dark tower.

shots.line: Written across one folder, in someone’s shaky hand: Pension. Last savings.
shots.scene: Insert: an open folder, shaky handwriting reading Pension. Last savings.

shots.line: Then the emergency comes.
shots.scene: Medium single: the hero’s head snapping up off the pillow toward the window.

shots.line: Leo’s apartment building, old wiring, and a spark catches in a stairwell at midnight.
shots.scene: 3D establishing: an old apartment block at midnight, one stairwell window glowing orange.

shots.line: Leo’s apartment building, old wiring, and a spark catches in a stairwell at midnight.
shots.scene: Insert: a worn outlet sparking in the stairwell, first flame climbing the wall paper.

shots.line: You’re three streets away.
shots.scene: Wide: the hero running down an empty street, a map line showing three streets between him and the fire.

shots.line: You calculate the fire’s spread rate instantly...
shots.scene: Blueprint: the stairwell drawn in section with a fire front spreading and math beside it.

shots.line: two meters every eight seconds... the exits closing in under two minutes.
shots.scene: Diagram: dimension arrows down the stair flight reading 2 m / 8 s while exit routes close one by one.

shots.line: You could run the model.
shots.scene: Insert: the running fire model clean and blue in the hero’s point of view.

shots.line: Or you could run.
shots.scene: Medium single: the model dissolving as the hero turns toward the door.

shots.line: The genius thing... or the right thing.
shots.scene: Two-shot on the street: the glowing model panel on one side, the burning doorway on the other.

shots.line: You run.
shots.scene: Flash: the hero sprinting through the door into the smoke, speed lines and camera shake.

shots.line: You take the stairs two at a time, dragging a confused family past the smoke, finding Leo by the one window still clear, hauling him out seconds before the hallway folds in on itself.
shots.scene: Action wide: the hero taking stairs two at a time through smoke, fire light rimming every edge.

shots.line: You take the stairs two at a time, dragging a confused family past the smoke, finding Leo by the one window still clear, hauling him out seconds before the hallway folds in on itself.
shots.scene: Interaction: the hero pulling a confused family of three along past a wall of smoke.

shots.line: You take the stairs two at a time, dragging a confused family past the smoke, finding Leo by the one window still clear, hauling him out seconds before the hallway folds in on itself.
shots.scene: Medium single: Leo behind the one clear window, the hero reaching up toward him.

shots.line: You take the stairs two at a time, dragging a confused family past the smoke, finding Leo by the one window still clear, hauling him out seconds before the hallway folds in on itself.
shots.scene: Reveal: the hallway folding in behind them in a flash of debris as the hero hauls Leo out.

shots.line: Outside, soot on your face, Leo coughs out a laugh.
shots.scene: Wide: the street outside, fire glow on wet pavement, soot-faced hero and Leo coughing into the night.

shots.line: Still think I’m not surprising?
shots.scene: Giant close-up: Leo, Still think I’m not surprising?

shots.line: You actually grin.
shots.scene: Giant close-up: the hero’s grin arriving before he can stop it.

shots.line: That one... I didn’t see coming.
shots.scene: Freeze frame: the grin held, ash particles hanging in the air, an UNPREDICTED badge in the corner.

shots.line: You hand Mr. Black’s folder to a reporter instead of his lab.
shots.scene: Two-shot: daylight pavement, the hero handing the folder to a reporter holding a recorder.

shots.line: The firm collapses within a week. The savings get returned.
shots.scene: Void insert: a data card with the firm’s curve collapsing straight down, then envelopes and coins streaming back out of it into waiting hands.

shots.line: You could have been richer than anyone alive.
shots.scene: Wide in the void: a gold tower on one side of the frame, the hero standing small on the other.

shots.line: Instead, you’re just... Leo’s friend again, three knocks and all.
shots.scene: Two-shot: cafeteria, hero and Leo shoulder to shoulder, three knock rings tapped on the table.

shots.line: And for the first time in months, his terrible joke actually catches you off guard.
shots.scene: Medium two-shot: Leo starting a joke, the hero already smiling on schedule, then stopping.

shots.line: And for the first time in months, his terrible joke actually catches you off guard.
shots.scene: Giant close-up: genuine surprise breaking across the hero’s face, the reward meter spiking.

shots.line: You laugh, right on time.
shots.scene: Wide: both of them laughing in warm afternoon light, trays forgotten.

shots.line: Is any of this real?
shots.scene: Chapter line IS ANY OF THIS REAL? over the blueprint void.

shots.line: Nobody has ever scored anywhere near one thousand on an IQ test...
shots.scene: Blueprint: the IQ scale drawn only to 300, a dashed line pointing far past its edge.

shots.line: the scale basically stops making sense that high.
shots.scene: Blueprint: the scale snapping in the middle with question marks in the gap.

shots.line: The highest ever recorded, by most estimates, sits closer to two hundred.
shots.scene: Data card: HIGHEST RECORDED settling near 200.

shots.line: And real intelligence was never just raw calculation. It’s judgment. It’s knowing what matters.
shots.scene: Blueprint: a brain on one pan of a balance, judgment and what matters loading the other pan down.

shots.line: Scientists still argue over what IQ even measures, and whether any number could capture a mind completely.
shots.scene: Wide: three scientists in lab coats arguing around a number line, a question cloud overhead.

shots.line: So could a mind really get that fast... and still stay kind?
shots.scene: Giant close-up: the hero soft and warm-rimmed, reading the question to himself.

shots.line: That night, your phone buzzes.
shots.scene: Insert: a phone buzzing face-up on a dark desk, screen lighting the room.

shots.line: Unknown number. One line.
shots.scene: Tight insert: the screen reading Unknown number as one line types itself out.

shots.line: We know what you did. We have a proposal.
shots.scene: Giant close-up: the hero’s face lit from below by the screen, the message glowing in his eyes.

shots.line: You stare at it a long time...
shots.scene: Medium single: the hero staring at the phone a long time, thumb unmoving.

shots.line: then set it face down.
shots.scene: Insert: the phone set face-down on the desk, light bleeding out from under it.

shots.line: So what would you actually solve first with a mind like that?
shots.scene: End screen: the question line over the whole cast lined up against a warm gradient.

shots.line: Tell us the one problem you’d fix by lunchtime.
shots.scene: End screen: comment bubble and the ask, cast still lined up below.

shots.line: And if Leo’s three knock code got you right in the feels... hit like, and subscribe for more What Ifs.
shots.scene: End screen: three knock rings then one over the subscribe pill, the whole cast.
